svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Whole pipeline (style to paint tree / display list)
Relative to the fastest engine of the row (log scale), faster to the left. The fastest engine of each row is 1x; dots are minimums, whiskers run to the median.
● Blitz par style: Blitz resolve() (parallel style)
● Blitz par style+construct: Blitz resolve() (parallel style+construct)
● Blitz #1034 all parallel: Blitz resolve() (parallel style+construct+layout)
